title: Street Corn Sweet Potato Beef Bowl
blurb: The salsa is built on blended cottage cheese instead of sour cream or mayo, which is where most of the protein in this bowl comes from without adding more meat.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment. Toss the cubed sweet potatoes with the avocado oil, salt and pepper. Spread in a single layer and roast 25 to 35 minutes, flipping halfway, until fork-tender and lightly caramelized.

Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until browned and no longer pink, about 6 to 8 minutes. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in the taco seasoning with the water and simmer 2 to 3 minutes until thickened.
In a bowl, combine the corn, blended cottage cheese, lime juice, jalapeño, cilantro and avocado. Stir until creamy and well mixed. Adjust lime and salt to taste.
Divide the roasted sweet potatoes between bowls. Top with the taco beef, then a generous scoop of the street corn salsa.
Sprinkle with Tajín and drizzle with hot honey. Serve immediately.
